milestone: Package 15: incident-report-check shipped; kit at 15 packages, 114 tests

package.name: dsh-incident-report-check
package.decides: postmortem structure: timestamped timeline, impact and duration, root cause not remedy, owned follow-ups
package.distinct_rule: 「重启后恢复」 is a remedy and the message says so — the rule requires a 根因 section, not a narrative of what was done

generalizable_finding.title: JavaScript \b never matches after a CJK character
generalizable_finding.detail: \b needs a \w neighbour and \w is [A-Za-z0-9_], so a pattern ending in 分钟\b can never match Chinese text. The first version of this package's duration rule had exactly that shape and its own test caught it: 持续 23 分钟 reported as duration-missing.
generalizable_finding.audit: grepped every package's src for the same shape (CJK followed by \b); the only other \b occurrences are k\b and s\b, which follow ASCII letters and are correct
generalizable_finding.why_it_matters: any linter pattern copied from English-only tooling silently never fires on Chinese input — a false-negative class that produces no error and no signal

quality_bar: 114 tests across the kit (9 new), audit 15/15 clean, site 16 pages, npm 0.1.0 live
